manaNeeded: {G}{W} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax if applicable
description:
Cast Dyadrine from the command zone by paying {G}{W} plus commander tax, if applicable, reduced by {1} for each time you've cast Dyadrine this game from the command zone due to Myth Unbound. Dyadrine will enter the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it for each mana spent to cast it.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Dyadrine, adding {1}.
Choose to return Dyadrine from the battlefield to the command zone.
When Dyadrine dies, Resourceful Defense triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler equal to the number Dyadrine had as it died.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing all +1/+1 counters placed on it in step 4, adding {G}{W} and then {1} for each remaining counter.
Repeat.
